integrity: The sharp inequality is proved analytically by converting the Aitken residual into a variance-to-second-moment ratio and optimizing that ratio over a bounded positive variable. The embedded verifier checks rational witnesses only; finite computation is not used as proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Positive coefficients and nonnegative geometric rates below one; one three-point Aitken transformation at a fixed index; exact arithmetic. Signed mixtures, negative modes, repeated Aitken iteration, higher epsilon-algorithm levels, and floating-point cancellation are not classified.
title: A sharp Aitken error bound for positive exponential mixtures
